metadata.description: AI CEO skills for founders, built for TOPY.AI. Core skills run on the TOPY MCP server (https://topy.ai/mcp); connected skills use it when available; standalone skills are CEO methods that work anywhere.

plugins.name: topy-ai
plugins.description: TOPY core: connects the TOPY MCP server and runs the AI CEO day to day — Alerts, Business plans, Connect to TOPY.AI, Customer personas, Daily CEO check-in, Decision log….

plugins.name: topy-ai-strategy
plugins.description: TOPY Strategy & direction skills (8): Business model, Competitive strategy, Decision memo, Market entry, OKRs, Prioritization…. Add the topy-ai plugin too, for the core skills and the TOPY MCP server.

plugins.name: topy-ai-fundraising
plugins.description: TOPY Fundraising skills (5): Cap table and dilution, Data room, Fundraising strategy, Pitch deck, Term sheet review. Add the topy-ai plugin too, for the core skills and the TOPY MCP server.

plugins.name: topy-ai-finance
plugins.description: TOPY Finance skills (6): Financial model, Monthly close, Plan vs actual, Pricing decisions, Runway and burn, Unit economics. Add the topy-ai plugin too, for the core skills and the TOPY MCP server.

plugins.name: topy-ai-operations
plugins.description: TOPY Operations & people skills (5): Board meetings, Hiring plan, KPI dashboard, Operating cadence, Org design. Add the topy-ai plugin too, for the core skills and the TOPY MCP server.

plugins.name: topy-ai-leadership
plugins.description: TOPY Leadership & decisions skills (4): CEO advisor, Crisis response, Debiasing a big decision, Stakeholder alignment. Add the topy-ai plugin too, for the core skills and the TOPY MCP server.

plugins.name: topy-ai-all
plugins.description: All 51 TOPY AI CEO skills in one install: TOPY core (MCP), Strategy & direction, Fundraising, Finance, Operations & people, Leadership & decisions.
